description: Defines the EmpPicture entity class used to represent employee pictures in the HRM system, including properties for image data, metadata, and ORM mapping configurations.

classes.name: EmpPicture
classes.description: Entity class representing employee picture data, including image blob and metadata, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this picture.

methods.name: getPicture
methods.description: Retrieves the picture data, which can be a string or resource.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the picture.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the picture.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the picture.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the picture.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the picture file.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the picture file.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the image.
